title: The Atonement of Christ
definition: The atonement is Christ's sacrificial work on the cross by which sinners are reconciled to God.
summary: Jesus bore sin's penalty, satisfied justice, displayed love, and opened the way of forgiveness and peace with God.
christFocus: Christ gave Himself for sinners so that all who trust Him might be forgiven, cleansed, and restored to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Jesus bore sin's penalty, satisfied justice, displayed love, and opened the way of forgiveness and peace with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
